## Summary

Describe what changed and why. Link related public issues when appropriate.

## Validation

List commands and results. Explicitly state omitted tests and unverified behavior.

## Security and Compatibility

Describe effects on authentication, tenant isolation, sensitive data, failure
behavior, dependencies and existing deployments. Include migration or rollback
instructions when needed. Write "not applicable" where appropriate.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
- [ ] This PR contains no credentials, private lab evidence or customer data.
- [ ] I used private reporting for any undisclosed vulnerability (SECURITY.md).
- [ ] I added relevant positive, negative and error-path tests, or explained why not.
- [ ] I updated public documentation and dependency locks where needed.
- [ ] I reported test results and limitations without claiming unverified coverage.
